headline: Head of the State Tax Service: We will find other jobs for managers who fail to master digitalization
summary: The State Tax Service collected 338 billion 222 million soms from January to October 2026 and fulfilled its ten-month plan ahead of schedule. The article also cites a growth rate in its revenue.
why: Tax collections show the fiscal health of a government's revenue base. Kyrgyzstan is a small, lightly traded economy, so these figures mainly matter for local budget and currency analysis.
original_headline: Глава ГНС: Не освоившим цифровизацию руководителям найдем другую работу
